tools.name: rename_assistant
tools.description: Rename the assistant to a new name chosen by the CDM. Call when CDM says 'call yourself X', 'rename to X', or similar.

tools.name: fetch_records
tools.description: Query AS requests from the database. Returns matching records.

tools.name: render_record_panel
tools.description: Render a record-card or status-timeline panel for a specific AS request.

tools.name: render_data_panel
tools.description: Render a data-display panel: record-table, kpi-strip, checklist, or rr-source.

data.description: Panel data — object or array depending on type

tools.name: render_action_panel
tools.description: Render an action panel. For email-draft type: you MUST call draft_price_email first and use its returned draft/subject/to values — never write email content yourself. For other types: field-form, confirm-dialog, ticket-ref.

config.description: Type-specific config. For email-draft: {emailText, to, subject} — values come from draft_price_email result. For field-form: {recordId, fields, editable}. For confirm-dialog: {message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel}. For ticket-ref: {ticketId, ticketUrl, system}.

tools.name: render_notice_panel
tools.description: Render a reminder-banner notice panel.

tools.name: rr_lookup
tools.description: Search the ingested R&R PDF documents using vector search. Use whenever a CDM asks about roles, responsibilities, who owns a task, or whether something is chargeable. Always call rr_lookup for R&R questions rather than answering from memory. If rr_lookup returns found:false → ask 1-2 targeted clarifying questions then call rr_lookup again. If rr_lookup returns too_broad:true (more than 3 codes) → ask 1-2 more specific narrowing questions then call rr_lookup again. Only show a result panel when rr_lookup returns 1-3 specific service codes.

description.description: Natural-language description of the service or task to match

codes.description: Optional list of candidate codes to narrow the search

tools.name: price_lookup
tools.description: Search the ingested AS Pricing List using vector search. Use whenever a CDM asks about price, cost, or EUR value of a service. If the CDM provides a specific service code (e.g. INFRA_1.8.10), call price_lookup directly — do NOT call rr_lookup first for pricing questions.

service_code.description: The R&R service code to look up (e.g. INFRA_1.8.10)

tools.name: parse_email
tools.description: Parse a raw customer email to extract AS request fields: customer name, service identifiers, ticket numbers, PO number, urgency notes.

raw_email.description: The full text of the customer email to parse

tools.name: draft_price_email
tools.description: Draft a price-communication email for an AS request.

customer_name.description: Customer display name for the salutation

service_codes.description: List of service codes covered by the email

prices.description: Map of service_code → price string, e.g. {"INFRA_1.8.10": "1500.00 EUR"}

tools.name: generate_o2i_ticket
tools.description: Generate the JIRA O2I invoice ticket body for an AS request. Returns the draft ticket for CDM review before submission.

request_id.description: The AS request ID to generate the O2I ticket for

tools.name: confirm_o2i_invoiced
tools.description: Confirm that the O2I JIRA ticket has been submitted and mark the AS request as Invoiced.

request_id.description: The AS request ID to mark as Invoiced

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Create a new AS request entry in the database. If creating from a raw customer email, call parse_email first to extract fields. If creating manually or with mock data, fill the fields directly — do NOT require an email. Always show the CDM a summary of what will be created and ask for confirmation before calling this. If an ACTIVE CUSTOMER SESSION is set, use that customer's name and ID automatically — do NOT ask the CDM which customer. Required: customerName, sid, assignedCDM. Include additionalServiceIds (R&R codes), description, poNumber, customerAccountId if available.

requestTitle.description: Short title for the request, e.g. 'HANA DB Upgrade — PRD'

additionalServiceIds.description: Comma-separated R&R service codes e.g. MOVE_1.3.04

description.description: Free-text description of the requested service

poNumber.description: PO number if provided in the email

assignedCDM.description: CDM email address — use the logged-in CDM

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Update fields on an AS request. Always show the CDM what will change before calling this.

tools.name: get_layout
tools.description: Read the CDM's current saved dashboard layout. Call this before propose_layout_change whenever the CDM asks to add, remove, or modify panels.

tools.name: propose_layout_change
tools.description: Suggest a change to the CDM saved workspace layout. Renders a confirm-dialog; only saves if CDM approves.

tools.name: get_reminder_status
tools.description: Check which reminder rules are currently firing for the CDM's open requests.

tools.name: route_to_agent
tools.description: Delegate to a Customer Orchestrator or Contract Subagent. Response comes back in same thread — CDM never sees the routing.

tools.name: surface_pending_action
tools.description: Create a PendingAction and push a card to the CDM Inbox.

tools.name: resolve_pending_action
tools.description: Mark a PendingAction as responded or dismissed.

tools.name: register_customer
tools.description: Create a new CustomerAgent entry and add it to the nav.

tools.name: link_session_to_customer
tools.description: Link the current general conversation session to a specific customer. Call this when the CDM's question is clearly about one specific customer and the session was started as a general (non-customer) chat. After linking, the session will appear under that customer in the sidebar.

customer_agent_id.description: The CustomerAgent.ID (UUID) to link this session to.

tools.name: register_contract
tools.description: Create a new ContractSubagent under an existing CustomerAgent.

tools.name: set_agent_status
tools.description: Change the lifecycle status of a customer, contract, or integration agent. Use when CDM says 'suspend', 'archive', 'retire', or 'reactivate' an agent. Always confirm intent before retiring — it creates a tombstone.

agentId.description: ID of the CustomerAgent, ContractSubagent, or IntegrationAgent

reason.description: Optional reason for the status change

tools.name: template_read
tools.description: Read a template by key. Checks private (CDM-owned) templates first, falls back to shared templates. Use when CDM asks to use a template, draft from a template, or 'use my price email'.

key.description: Template key, e.g. 'price_email', 'jira_o2i', or a custom name the CDM gave their template

cdm_email.description: CDM email for private template lookup — omit to get shared only

tools.name: template_write
tools.description: Save or update a personal template for the CDM. Use when CDM says 'save this as my template', 'remember this format', or 'create a template called X'.

description.description: Short description of what the template is for

tools.name: notes_read
tools.description: Read the CDM's personal reference notes. Use when CDM asks about their saved notes, personal process info, or when context suggests personal reference data would help.

query.description: Optional search query to filter relevant notes

tools.name: notes_write
tools.description: Save a personal note for the CDM. Use when CDM says 'remember this', 'save this', 'note that', or wants to store process info or reference text for later.

tags.description: Optional comma-separated tags for searching later

relatedRequest.description: Optional AS request ID this note is about

tools.name: inject_document
tools.description: Load a document into context for this turn only. Content is ephemeral — not stored anywhere. Use when CDM uploads or pastes a document they want to ask questions about.

content.description: Full document text or extracted PDF content

title.description: Document title or filename for reference

tools.name: process_meeting_notes
tools.description: Extract structured data from raw ops meeting notes and store it on the client's dashboard. Call this when the user pastes or uploads meeting notes text. The tool identifies the client automatically from the notes content.

raw_text.description: The full raw meeting notes text pasted or uploaded by the CDM

tools.name: patch_meeting_note
tools.description: Apply one or more targeted updates to the stored meeting notes for the active client. Call this when the CDM types a natural-language update like 'topic 3 is now closed', 'mark risk 1 as resolved', 'add action: Palash to check FMX by Friday', 'update topic 8 owner to Sudhir', or 'add decision: agreed to defer profile changes to April'. The tool applies the patches in memory and returns a human-readable diff — show the diff to the CDM and ask for confirmation BEFORE calling confirm_meeting_note_patch.

patches.description: List of patch operations to apply

target.description: Topic id, action text, risk id, or 'narrative' depending on op

value.description: New value — status string, owner name, date, bullet text, action text, decision text, or narrative paragraph

tools.name: confirm_meeting_note_patch
tools.description: Write the pending meeting note patches to the database. Only call this AFTER patch_meeting_note has returned a diff AND the CDM has explicitly confirmed the changes.
